sprint: Sprint 08 — Two-Player Multiplayer Lobbies & Real-Time Sessions

results.name: Lobby creation returns HTTP 201 Created for eligible game
Joinable lobby payload includes unique lobby ID
Invitation code is displayed and matches 6-character uppercase format
Lobby max_players is strictly constrained to 2 players
Host player is automatically registered as first participant (1/2)
Initial lobby status is set to "waiting" with unfilled slot (AC-18.1)
Lobby creation for solo-only game (Cyber Invaders) is rejected with HTTP 422
Error code specifies GAME_NOT_ELIGIBLE_FOR_MULTIPLAYER
Diagnostic error message indicates single-player constraint (max players: 1)
Lobby creation for non-existent game returns HTTP 404
Prior to opponent join, lobby status is "waiting"
Unfilled slot is reflected in playerCount = 1 / maxPlayers = 2
Join lobby with valid code returns HTTP 200 OK
Case-insensitive invitation code successfully matches target lobby
Guest player is registered in participants list with role "guest"
When lobby reaches allowed capacity (2), status transitions to "full" (AC-18.2)
isFull flag evaluates to true upon reaching 2 participants
Third player attempting to join 2-player lobby is rejected with HTTP 409 Conflict
Error code specifies LOBBY_FULL
Rejection details confirm maximum capacity reached (2/2 players)
Lobby membership remains strictly 2 players (unadmitted player excluded)
Non-existent invitation code is rejected with HTTP 404
Error code specifies INVALID_INVITATION_CODE
Expired invitation code is rejected with HTTP 410 Gone
Error code specifies INVITATION_CODE_EXPIRED with 30-minute explanation
Non-host guest cannot start the match (HTTP 403 Forbidden)
Host starting match returns HTTP 200 OK
Lobby status transitions to "active" upon match start (AC-18.3)
Linked multiplayer game session ID is generated
Public status query confirms lobby status is "active"
WebSocket handshake completes and authenticates host via ambient cookie
WebSocket handshake completes and authenticates guest via ambient cookie
Unauthenticated WebSocket connection is accepted in unauthenticated/guest state
Host receives LOBBY_CREATED event via WebSocket with status "waiting"
Guest receives LOBBY_JOINED event via WebSocket
Host receives real-time LOBBY_STATE_CHANGED broadcast with status "full"
Host receives real-time LOBBY_MEMBER_JOINED broadcast identifying joined guest
Both host and guest simultaneously receive MATCH_STARTED with status "active"
Opponent receives synchronized GAME_STATE_UPDATE move without latency
Cross-room isolation verified: Unrelated sockets receive zero leaked room events
Session revocation listener terminates active WebSocket connection on logout
Untrusted Cross-Origin WebSocket request (CSWSH defense) is rejected with HTTP 403
Reusable raw session token in WebSocket URL is rejected with HTTP 400
Authenticated player requests short-lived single-use WS ticket (60s TTL, audience scoped)
Client connects and authenticates using single-use connection ticket (?ticket=wst_...)
Reused connection ticket is rejected as single-use (authenticated: false)
Passing raw session token in message is rejected with RAW_SESSION_TOKENS_FORBIDDEN
Pre-authorization lobby preview redacts participant details and PII (participants empty)
Duplicate join by already admitted player succeeds idempotently without duplicate participant slots
Repeated invalid code attempts trigger rate limiting (HTTP 429 TOO_MANY_FAILED_ATTEMPTS with Retry-After)
Safe generic error response returned for invalid code without stack trace or DB schema leak
